title: Flipping Nested Containers
goal: Swap Option and Result layers using transpose.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Option and Result

hints: Mapping over Option<&str> with parse gives Option<Result<u32, ParseIntError>>.
Use transpose to swap Option<Result<T, E>> into Result<Option<T>, E>.
explanation: Mapping `val.parse()` over `Option<&str>` yields `Option<Result<u32, ParseIntError>>`. Calling `.transpose()` turns `Option<Result<T, E>>` into `Result<Option<T>, E>`. Applying `?` or `.unwrap()` would extract the inner `Option`, causing type error `E0308` against the expected `Result` return type.
